history.body: Hi, we’re looking around Seberang Jaya for a place to buy and Pearl Residences came up. We have a young child and need a separate bedroom for them, so could you tell me about the 3-bedroom layout and the usual monthly costs?

Hi! Pearl Residences’ Type A is 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, so there’s a separate bedroom for your child and two other bedrooms. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor. Exact room and furniture fit should be checked against the approved plan.

The verified maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq ft, inclusive of the sinking fund—RM162/month for 900 sq ft. I’m checking whether there are other regular project charges before giving you a fuller monthly-cost picture. A viewing could also help you judge whether the layout works for your family; happy to help arrange one if useful.

Thanks, having a separate room for our child is important, so the layout sounds like it could work. I’d like to check the approved plan and understand the other regular charges before deciding whether to come see it. Could you let me know once you’ve confirmed those costs?

Understood. Type A still looks promising for your child to have a separate bedroom, but the layout information I have is a concept, not the approved plan, so I can’t confirm the exact room arrangement or fit yet. RM162/month for maintenance, including the sinking fund, is the only recurring charge I can confirm so far; I don’t have a verified total for other regular charges. I’ll update you when I have the approved-plan details and charge confirmation, so you can decide about a viewing with a clearer picture.
